title: Archive
description: data of: archive.py dips STAR --json, one star's dips in its Kepler light curve (MAST), each with its verdict after the artefact checks; and of archive.py search FILE_OR_IDS --json, each star's dips left, the most Tabby-like first. Nothing moves.

asymmetry.description: -1 to 1: positive when the recovery is slower than the fall.

flags.description: Kepler quality flags (attitude tweak, safe mode, coarse or Earth point, momentum dump, manual exclude) near the faintest point.

verdict.description: dip: left after the checks; edge: faintest at a quarter's end or a gap; spacecraft: a short dip on a quality flag; periodic: like dips at whole multiples of one interval (an eclipsing binary or planet); variability: dips over much of the curve.

sap_depth_percent.description: Its depth in the SAP flux (before the mission's cleaning) over the same span.

seen_in.description: Whether SAP shows it at least half as deep; SAP only: a dip in SAP that the cleaned flux does not have.

trend.description: The star's slow change with the quarters joined at their edges (not each put on its own level). Null with too little.

change_percent.description: The last 30 days against the first 30.

scatter_percent.description: The light curve's robust scatter (1.4826 x median absolute deviation).

tabby_like.description: A dip left that is at least 5% deep.

score.description: The dips left, each its depth in percent times (1 + |asymmetry|), added.

tic.description: archive.py tess: the star's TESS Input Catalog number.

mission.description: Kepler: times are BKJD (BJD - 2454833), quarters; TESS: BTJD (BJD - 2457000), sectors, 2-minute points binned to 30.

sap_only.description: Dips in SAP that no PDCSAP dip covers: what the cleaning took out, the spacecraft's until shown otherwise.

trend.description: The long-term change in each flux; PDCSAP's cleaning takes out most of a slow change, SAP keeps it.

screened.description: screen: Kepler stars screened so far, in all runs.

order.description: The order stars are taken in.

top.description: screen: every star screened so far, Tabby-like first, then by score; at most 20.
